name: 2D Planar Image Alignment
aliases: Joint optimization of 2D image content and per-patch homography warps
definition: Joint optimization of 2D image content F2d and per-patch homography warps P2d using reconstruction loss on overlapping image patches.
summary: 2D Planar Image Alignment jointly optimizes image content and homography warps to align overlapping patches, distinguishing itself by prioritizing geometric consistency over smoothness priors.
